meta.title: 衣服好坏分辨真的很简单
meta.title_en: How to Judge Clothing Quality, Simply

scenes.context: 半裙想知道版型好不好，侧面看臀围这块是不是向外凸出的。
sentences: Judge a skirt by its hip area.
Look from the side for any bulge.
paraphrase: Judge a skirt by its hip area.
Look from the side for any bulge.
scenes.speak: Judge a skirt by its hip area. Look from the side for any bulge.

scenes.context: 好版型下摆久穿也不会往外翘，侧面看基本上是直直下来的。
sentences: The hem never flares out even after wear.
From the side it hangs perfectly straight.
paraphrase: The hem never flares out even after wear.
From the side it hangs perfectly straight.
scenes.speak: The hem never flares out even after wear. From the side it hangs perfectly straight.

scenes.context: 没给臀围什么放量的，就算臀再翘也能给你压平了，显得紧绷。
sentences: There's no ease built in for the hip.
Even a curvy hip gets flattened.
paraphrase: There's no ease built in for the hip.
Even a curvy hip gets flattened.
scenes.speak: There's no ease built in for the hip. Even a curvy hip gets flattened.

scenes.context: 人体表面凹凸不平，通过做胸省腰省，让该凸的凸该收的收，放大优点掩盖缺点才是好版型。
sentences: Good fit comes from bust and waist darts.
paraphrase: Good fit comes from bust and waist darts.
scenes.speak: Good fit comes from bust and waist darts. Highlight strengths and hide flaws.

scenes.context: 前后都是平的、跟张纸似的，穿身上能舒适能好看吗？
sentences: It's flat as a sheet of paper.
How can it look good on a body?
paraphrase: It's flat as a sheet of paper.
How can it look good on a body?
scenes.speak: It's flat as a sheet of paper. How can it look good on a body?

scenes.context: 最差的半裙前后跟一片似的，腰头松紧带一收，这不叫半裙，叫腰围放大器。
sentences: An elastic waistband that cinches everything.
这简直是个腰围放大器。
paraphrase: An elastic waistband that cinches everything.
scenes.speak: An elastic waistband that cinches everything. It's basically a waist magnifier.

scenes.context: 半裙选多片结构的，通过结构做出大小对比，腰部平整不鼓囊，显得腰细。
sentences: A flat waistband makes the waist look small.
paraphrase: A flat waistband makes the waist look small.
scenes.speak: Choose a multi-panel skirt. A flat waistband makes the waist look small.

scenes.context: 好衣服的细节靠做工与结构，面料颜色与缝线呼应，整体才会显高级。
scenes.speak: Thread color matches the fabric. Details make the difference.

practice: 判断半裙版型先看臀围，怎么说？
Judge a skirt by its hip area.
Good fit comes from bust and waist darts.
The hem never flares out even after wear.
多片结构让腰显得更细。
Multi-panel construction makes the waist look small.
pitfalls: 人体凹凸不平，没省道就压不住
腰头松紧一收是腰围放大器
看缝线颜色是否与面料呼应
